text:
Sara (PM): quick sync — Q2 console observability priorities. Customers asking for token-level cost breakdown (model+route), plus better error analytics and tracing hooks for private deploys. Need to decide order + launch criteria.
Kevin (Eng): +1. My rough estimate: cost breakdown (hosted only) = 2 wks infra + 1 wk frontend. Error analytics (basic) = 1.5 wks. Tracing hooks = 3 wks (sdk work + runtime).
Ali (SRE): for tracing hooks we need a stable sampling config. Also want a non-prod flag for sending traces externally. Security requirements for private customers may add 1-2 wks.
Ryan (Data): to support cost breakdown we need token attribution per inference + route metadata in events. We can add aggregated rollups by day/hour. Requires schema change + migration.
Emily (Design): I can do dashboard templates (cost + errors) in 1 week if backend exposes the metrics. Need example queries and a data contract.
Ben (CS): FYI major finserv customer will pay for cost-by-route if hosted included. Their ask: downloadable CSV and per-team billing. Can we include export in MVP?
Sara (PM): proposal: MVP v1 = hosted cost breakdown (model+route) with export CSV + dashboard template. V1 acceptance: per-request token attribution, aggregated daily rollups, CSV export, UI with top-10 routes. V2 = tracing hooks + error analytics + private deployment support.
Kevin (Eng): ok for hosted-only MVP. To be explicit launch criteria: API for aggregations, UI table, CSV export, docs + migration plan. Also e2e test that numbers match billing pipeline.
Ali (SRE): add: logging level flag, data retention 90d, VPC-safe export disabled for private by default.
Ryan (Data): sample query for dashboard:
```
SELECT model, route, SUM(tokens) as tokens, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM inference_events
WHERE ts >= now()-7d
GROUP BY model, route
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
This will power the top routes widget.
Emily (Design): UI wireframes uploaded to Figma: (private link). Minimal table + sparkline per route + export button.
Sara (PM): timeline? Can we commit to dev in sprint starting Mon? Who owns implementation?
Kevin (Eng): Eng can take ownership, I'll schedule a spike this week to confirm perf impact on metrics pipeline. Assigning to @kevin.
Ben (CS): I can draft the customer-facing release note and coordinate pilot with finserv.
roadie-bot: Reminder: please add tickets to the 'console/metrics' epic by EOD Thu.
Sara (PM): scope negotiation: if spike shows pipeline can't handle raw token-level events, fall back to sampled attribution (configurable). Decision required by end of spike.
Ali (SRE): +1 for fallback. Also recommend canary rollout to 5% of traffic first.
Kevin (Eng): noted. I'll post spike findings in this thread by Fri.
Sara (PM): great — next steps: Kevin spike, Ryan schema changes PR, Emily wireframes -> prototyping, Ben customer pilot. I'll own acceptance criteria and launch checklist. :thumbsup:
